unit: one separately approved finite-sigma pilot run; no sharing unused budget or retry
proposal_reason: S0 single-run 9000 s / native 7200 s and 6 GiB disk-growth scenario retained as proposals. 8 GiB RSS and 10 GiB private-commit early stops, 12 GiB future Job-commit limit, 2 GiB host reserves are conservative proposed stop policies, NOT measured needs, guaranteed sufficiency, or inherited approvals. They require user acceptance and implementation validation; inability to proceed within them stops instead of relaxing them.

counter_definitions.name: job_rss_bytes
counter_definitions.scope: sum WorkingSetSize once per unique private-Job member PID+creation-time pair, including root; do not add root or Job total again
counter_definitions.interpretation: RSS can double-count shared pages across processes; it is an operational summed RSS, not unique resident physical memory

counter_definitions.name: job_private_commit_bytes
counter_definitions.scope: one Job accounting total including all members; never add process totals to Job total
counter_definitions.interpretation: private committed bytes, not RSS and not system pagefile occupancy
counter_definitions.current_support: OPEN exact Windows Job counter/API and enforcement adapter need implementation plus primary documentation and changed-branch validation

counter_definitions.name: host_commit_available_bytes
counter_definitions.scope: host commit limit minus commit total; not available physical RAM
counter_definitions.current_support: OPEN current legacy availablePage field is not automatically accepted as this metric

counter_definitions.name: host_available_ram_bytes
counter_definitions.current_support: legacy start-only GlobalMemoryStatusEx observation exists; periodic sampler OPEN

counter_definitions.name: owned_output_growth_bytes
counter_definitions.scope: sum allocated/logical size convention to be fixed before native: proposed logical bytes for all files exclusively created under run/evidence/staging, including MPH/CSV/log/base64/temp; pre-existing originals excluded
counter_definitions.current_support: OPEN ownership-scoped periodic walker; reparse/link/permission failure stops; originals never deleted to restore reserve

counter_definitions.name: volume_free_bytes
counter_definitions.scope: current volume available free space; includes external use impact
counter_definitions.current_support: legacy start-only free-disk observation exists; periodic sampler OPEN

counter_definitions.name: native_elapsed_s
counter_definitions.scope: monotonic native phase wall time including compilation/output/monitor; not physical time or solver-only time
counter_definitions.current_support: legacy monotonic deadline precedent; new integration OPEN

observations.sampled_max: maximum successful in-scope samples, with timestamps and gaps; lower bound on unknown interval peak
observations.os_peak: separate named OS counter with definition/coverage if implemented; null when unavailable
observations.enforced_limit: separate verified OS limit if actually configured/read back under native approval; currently none implemented by this candidate
observations.detection_latency: sample schedule 5 s + maximum accepted sample duration 1 s; stale sample >6 s stops. Scheduling/OS stalls may exceed this; not a hard real-time guarantee
observations.growth_overshoot: 5 to 6 GiB and 10 to 12 GiB margins are proposed early-stop reserves; no measured maximum write/allocation rate exists, so overshoot cannot be bounded by this plan. Native review must accept sampled-only residual risk or separately implement OS quota; no silent fallback.

ownership.identity: private Job held handle, root PID and creation FILETIME, assigned-before-resume proof, unique current membership pairs, observed lifetime members
ownership.never: process-name kill, global COMSOL kill, old PID reuse, parent PID alone, caller-supplied list without fresh Job confirmation
ownership.measurement_failure: STOP_REQUIRED; missing value remains null, never zero/PASS
ownership.ownership_failure: no unknown-process kill; preserve UNRESOLVED and prohibit later phase/retry

sequence: wait up to 15 s bounded by remaining cleanup and overall deadlines while reserving 90 s for force/verify
force remaining owned private Job once
verify Job empty AND held root signaled AND exit query succeeded; then close owned handles and record
stop.cooperative_method: OPEN: legacy winjob has no cooperative COMSOL stop implementation. Do not label TerminateJobObject or kill-on-close graceful.
stop.without_cooperative_method: native gate blocks unless a distinct explicit force-only path is accepted in the future one-run approval and tested. Its use records cooperative unavailable, not successful.
stop.TerminateJobObject: forceful owned-Job termination only; never cooperative
stop.hard_limit_event: no wait beyond cap; stop initiation reserves cleanup, force and record time. If unavailable time, record deadline breach and remaining ownership without invented termination PASS.
stop.implementation: candidate/control.py.inactive.txt::advance_stop is pure transition logic only; no OS callback invoked in S1-O

required_before_native: exact sampler APIs and aggregation implementation
OS Job-commit limit implementation/readback or explicit separately reviewed removal of hard-limit proposal
supported cooperative method or separately approved force-only path
identity-preserving adapter and bounded stop integration
changed-branch inert validation and independent acceptance
current resource read-only observations and explicit one-run limit/risk approval
